'''Ryell''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rydonni Prime]]. It was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] ruling family, the [[K'ntarr family]], as well the location where the [[Rythani Products Building]] was based. Numerous [[Skyscraper/Legends|starscrapers]] were located in this city and a royal parade took place there at some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="Easy">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref>
